Revenue is calculated as revenue from operations as per the Restated Consolidated Financial Information.
Revenue Growth is calculated as the rate of increase in revenue as compared to the previous year.
Profit after tax (“PAT”) is calculated as the restated consolidated profit after tax for the period.
PAT Margin is calculated as PAT divided by revenue from operations, and the resultant is multiplied by 100.
EBITDA is calculated as the sum of profit before tax, finance costs and depreciation less other income.
EBITDA Margin is calculated as EBITDA as a ratio of revenue from operations for the period.
Return on Equity (“RoE”) is calculated as PAT divided by average total equity, and the resultant is multiplied by 100.

AI servers and workstations (%) is calculated as revenue from AI servers and workstations segment divided by revenue from operations, and the resultant is multiplied by 100.
HCI (%) is calculated as revenue from HCI segment divided by revenue from operations, and the resultant is multiplied by 100.
Data centre servers (%) is calculated as revenue from data centre servers segment divided by revenue from operations, and the resultant is multiplied by 100.
HPC systems (%) is calculated as revenue from HPC systems segment divided by revenue from operations, and the resultant is multiplied by 100.
Software and services (%) is calculated as revenue from software and services segment divided by revenue from operations, and the resultant is multiplied by 100.
HPS (%) is calculated as revenue from HPS segment divided by revenue from operations, and the resultant is multiplied by 100.
Government customers (%) is calculated as revenue from government customers divided by revenue from operations, and the resultant is multiplied by 100.

emails.subject: Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund | Pre-IPO & Anchor interest – Meganet Technologies Global Limited
emails.text:
Dear Ritu Sharma and Disha Doshi,

I am CA Deep Dalal, Fund Manager of Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund. I am writing to you as the Book Running Lead Manager to the proposed IPO of Meganet Technologies Global Limited, whose Draft Red Herring Prospectus dated November 16, 2026 has been filed with SEBI for listing on the Main Board of BSE and NSE.

ABOUT US
Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund is a SEBI-registered Category III Alternative Investment Fund focused on India's primary markets. We invest through Pre-IPO placements, IPO Anchor Investor books, the QIB portion of IPOs and Qualified Institutional Placements (QIPs), working closely with promoters and merchant bankers through the listing journey.

OUR VIEW ON MEGANET TECHNOLOGIES GLOBAL
Meganet Technologies Global is a full-stack AI infrastructure provider offering a comprehensive suite of high-performance computing solutions and related products and services supported by fully integrated design and manufacturing capabilities. We have studied the DRHP closely, and the business and its growth trajectory fit well with our investment focus.

Key financials (restated, ₹ crore unless stated)
                                    Sep-26*       FY26       FY25       FY24
Revenue from operations (₹ cr)        1,225     447.12     368.31     311.78
Growth (YoY)                              –      21.4%      18.1%          –
EBITDA (₹ cr)                         61.55      52.48      39.85      34.58
EBITDA margin                          5.0%      11.7%      10.8%      11.1%
Profit after tax (₹ cr)               42.57      37.94      30.22      25.29
PAT margin                             3.5%       8.5%       8.2%       8.1%
Net worth (₹ cr)                     162.26     119.85      81.28      50.77
Return on net worth                   26.2%      31.7%      37.2%      49.8%
Debt / Equity                         0.40x      0.04x      0.02x          –
* Sep-26: interim period, not annualised.
Source: restated financial information in the DRHP; EBITDA and ratios computed from it.

HOW WE WOULD LIKE TO PARTICIPATE
  1. Pre-IPO placement: The DRHP contemplates a Pre-IPO Placement of up to 20% of the Fresh Issue. We would be keen to participate in this round.
  2. Anchor Investor portion: As a SEBI-registered Category III AIF, we qualify as a QIB and would like to be considered for the anchor book.
  3. QIB portion: We would also look to participate in the QIB portion of the IPO.

FUND PROFILE
View our fund profile (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yQX3TH3nmyqzt6rICyliVYFCP1okKqVv/view?usp=sharing (also attached)

I would be grateful if you could introduce us to the promoters of Meganet Technologies Global (Amrish Dulraj Pipada, Amit Dulraj Pipada and Shreyans Amrish Pipada) and keep us informed as the pre-IPO and anchor book discussions progress. A short call at your convenience would be much appreciated.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

CA Deep Dalal
Fund Manager, Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund
SEBI-registered Category III AIF
Email: fundmanager@parshwanath.in
WhatsApp: +91 83200 52970
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 70690 06298
